post_owner_name: Susie Allison, M. Ed | Busy Toddler
caption:
Don’t sleep on this.

Behold the never-ending story of my fall EVERY.SINGLE.YEAR. 
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
This is too easy not to try: let kids paint the pumpkins, wash those pumpkins, and repeat this again and again.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
HOW I SET THIS UP:
I set two bins outside ➡️ one for water and one for pumpkin painting. I added some scrubby brushes for washing but honestly, use what you have.

FAQ:
-I used washable paint from @discountschoolsupplies
-My bins are 41qt tubs from Target
-Yes the paint comes off 😉
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
At the risk of sounding very old, from me to you: this is genuinely one of my favorite things to do with kids each fall. I have so many photos of this activity over the years and it fills me with so many warm memories of days behind us ♥️♥️♥️

Share it, save it, try it 🎉
